shortDescription: Prepare certificates required for ACME challenges such as C(tls-alpn-01)

options.name: challenge_data
options.description: The RV(community.crypto.acme_certificate#module:challenge_data) entry provided by M(community.crypto.acme_certificate) for the challenge.

options.name: private_key_content
options.description: Content of the private key to use for this challenge certificate. Mutually exclusive with O(private_key_src).

options.name: private_key_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase to use to decode the private key.

options.name: private_key_src
options.description: Path to a file containing the private key file to use for this challenge certificate. Mutually exclusive with O(private_key_content).
